_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). Floors are UNCHANGED in the prompt-gaps PR (prompt_version moved f3a5ad27 -> f2ab7e77 via the count + honest-refusal SYSTEM_PROMPT rules); the committed real-capture fixtures go uniformly STALE -> advisory gate keeps CI green and NO quality floor is evaluated until the human re-captures. PENDING POST-MERGE RATCHET (runbook step 5, eval/README.md): after `capture --force` + `replay`, read the lifted T4_answer_correct / out_of_scope_honest rates from report.md and set these floors ~5pp under (the same calibration #36 used), then commit. Bank GROWTH for the newly closed failure modes is a DEFERRED follow-up PR cut together with that re-capture (resolved decision 1: D-defer; min_fixtures==bank size, so growth must be captured live, not left MISSING). Prior measured baseline (report.json @ f3a5ad27, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.78 (28/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.75 (18/24); 1 in-scope case = 2.8pp. Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
